# asaas()->installment

Class `Asaas\Laravel\Services\InstallmentService`. Bodies and queries are arrays; unknown query keys are rejected.

## `list(array $params = []): InstallmentList`
GET /v3/installments
query: offset, limit
docs: https://docs.asaas.com/reference/listar-parcelamentos

## `create(array $data): Installment`
POST /v3/installments
required: installmentCount, customer, value, billingType, dueDate
required if parent sent: splits.*.walletId
docs: https://docs.asaas.com/reference/criar-parcelamento

## `createWithCreditCard(array $data): Installment`
POST /v3/installments/
required: installmentCount, customer, value, billingType, dueDate, creditCard (or creditCardToken), creditCardHolderInfo (or creditCardToken), remoteIp
required if parent sent: splits.*.walletId, creditCard.holderName, creditCard.number, creditCard.expiryMonth, creditCard.expiryYear, creditCard.ccv, creditCardHolderInfo.name, creditCardHolderInfo.email, creditCardHolderInfo.cpfCnpj, creditCardHolderInfo.postalCode, creditCardHolderInfo.addressNumber, creditCardHolderInfo.phone, threeDSecure.callbackUrl, deviceInfo.colorDepth, deviceInfo.screenHeight, deviceInfo.screenWidth, deviceInfo.timeZoneOffset, deviceInfo.language, deviceInfo.userAgent, deviceInfo.remoteIp
docs: https://docs.asaas.com/reference/criar-parcelamento-com-cartão-de-crédito
